links.outcome: Reading level (Flesch-Kincaid) of chatbot outputs on Wilms tumor
links.effect: Median Flesch-Kincaid Readability 46.7 (IQR 41.1-52.2), advanced reading ease comparable to a high school or college student.
links.quote: The median word count per output from the AIs was 275 (IQR 156-322), with an advanced ease of reading level comparable to a high school or college student, median Flesch-Kincaid Readability level of 46.7 (IQR 41.1-52.2).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of commercial LLM chatbots answering patient queries about Wilms tumor using standardized quality/readability instruments without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
